finding: With MULTIPLE_PREMIER_BALLS_AT_ONCE disabled, any ball purchase awarded one Premier Ball, including quantities below ten.
fix: The single-bonus branch awards one only when purchased quantity is at least ten.
coverage: Both compiled configuration branches, quantities 0..999, ball/nonball pocket, no keys/A/B/both keys, and successful/failed bonus bag insertion. Checks award quantity, single/plural message and return-to-list behavior.
rom_control_flow: Original BPRJ disassembly at 0x0809B8AA calls AddBagItem; failure branches at 0x0809B8B8 to 0x0809B8E4. ReloadMartList hook at 0x0809B8BA is reached only after success. Original subtract-money callback at 0x0809B8FC uses the latched ShopData.itemPrice at offset 8.
limitations: Mocked bag/pocket/message functions; actual pocket contents, linked hooks, money update and GBA runtime remain unverified.
